title: Stop arguing with what is already under Hukam
summary: What comes to pass is already moving under the Divine will. Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
takeaway: Return to Hukam before the self starts arguing again.
lifeApplication: When regret starts litigating the past again, stop where you are standing and let the line name the larger order. Consent before the mind starts prosecuting reality.

source.shortMeaning: What comes to pass is already moving under the Divine will.
source.lifeApplication: When regret reopens, return the moment to Hukam before arguing again.
